craft_notes: Sthāyin: southern count. Rows: elapsed then noon. Read aloud: harvest tally.

lines: Then, five crossings past, in thirteen-and-three-quarter clocks gone by,
at southern harvest noon, nine hundred breaths.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tataḥ saṃkrāntipañcake vṛtte pādonāsu caturdaśasu ghaṭikāsu atikrāntāsu dakṣiṇaṃ śāradaṃ viṣuvanmadhyāhne nava prāṇaśatāni
